name: Leverage Shares -1x Uber ETC
summary: Leverage Shares -1x Uber ETC is an exchange-traded commodity (ETC) that aims to provide the inverse of the daily performance of Uber's stock. This ETC uses leverage to magnify the inverse return, meaning it gains when Uber's stock price falls and loses when it rises. It is designed for short-term trading strategies seeking to profit from a decline in Uber's stock.
